text: A crack in the Earth so deep it could swallow Everest. A place where light dies, where a single window crack could have ended the first dive, where fish glow and shrimp grow giant.
A place that, very slowly, is drinking the ocean... and breathing it back out.
And still, we've explored only a tiny part of it. Most of the deep sea floor has never been seen up close by human eyes. Not once.
[winding his pocket watch, grinning] So the bottom of the world... still has secrets.
It does. And we'll keep going after them.
If you want to see where we dive next, subscribe to BHUGOL. And tell us in the comments: would you get into that little steel ball and go down?
